body:
## Status: FILE ONLY / UNROUTED
Guy authorized redesign scoping and issue filing, not dispatch, implementation, fleet resume, PR, merge or release. No labels or assignees. Visual implementation requires approved prototype evidence and separate routing approval.

## Preserved contract
Accepted V1 panorama + R2 ranch environment + original V1 horse design and corrected grazing anatomy. Native procedural SwiftUI Canvas/Path with distinct/exportable layers; no flattened raster scene, video backdrop, WebView, new engine or service dependency. Same authoritative live model, filters, composite identities, blocked rail and Recent Output destination. Preserve truthful offline/unknown states and accessible operation. Day/Night/Auto environment remains independent of the app's Catppuccin preference. No daemon, SSE, pairing, grant, APNs or release work.

## Design dependency
Refs #455 — owner-selected contract and visual gate. Depends on approved prototype/spec, plus explicit routing. Refs #442/#444; do not duplicate gait #448 or repository ordering #449.

## Small scope
Extend native RanchPainter.tree and existing grass bending to use a shared deterministic wind phase with small per-tree/cluster variation. Canopies/leaf clusters sway gently; trunks remain grounded. Existing 100ms HerdClock is the starting point, not proof of sufficient animation quality. Reuse one scene timing owner; measure cadence and isolate rendering invalidation before raising update rate.

## Source
https://github.com/jirathip-dev/corral/blob/86d1287a9e5c611ec6bef677c95544c53e71b982/ios/FleetNotifier/UI/Herd/RanchEnvironment.swift#L144-L174
https://github.com/jirathip-dev/corral/blob/86d1287a9e5c611ec6bef677c95544c53e71b982/ios/FleetNotifier/UI/Herd/HerdModel.swift#L87-L115
https://github.com/jirathip-dev/corral/blob/86d1287a9e5c611ec6bef677c95544c53e71b982/ios/FleetNotifier/UI/Herd/HerdView.swift#L62-L64

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Visible gentle canopy/leaf-cluster movement and coherent grass response through real procedural geometry, preserving approved silhouettes, grounded trunks and Day/Night palette.
- [ ] Deterministic time/identity phase; no random-per-frame jitter, per-leaf timers, multiplying tasks or flattened animated assets.
- [ ] Render sampled phases through actual renderer and prove changed canopy geometry; regression must fail against static tree implementation. Native runtime video demonstrates motion at actual phone scale.
- [ ] App/system Reduce Motion resolves to an intentional static scene; obscured, background, disappeared and Board-mode scene stops work. Preserve existing no-fake-live disconnected policy; no new lifecycle animation beyond active scene.
- [ ] Document/probe Low Power and thermal fallback (prefer disabling ambient motion), with deterministic tests; avoid per-frame recomputation of live fleet projections.
- [ ] Measure baseline versus animated CPU/frame cadence on a named device/build with dense horses; bounded workload and no persistent timer after dismissal. Physical iPhone review before claiming smooth/battery-safe motion.
- [ ] Native/CI gates pass. Horse legs remain #448; do not change their renderer here. Sky child consumes the shared timing/wind contract rather than introducing its own timer.
title: Herd ambience: add coherent wind-driven tree canopy and grass motion
